description: This Java class 'PaymentDBUtil' provides database utility methods for performing CRUD operations and additional functionalities related to 'Payment' objects, such as retrieving all payments, inserting, updating, deleting payments, and creating a new payment with ID retrieval.

classes.name: PaymentDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to perform database operations related to payments.

methods.name: getAllPayment
methods.description: Retrieves all payment records from the database and returns them as a list of Payment objects.

methods.name: insertPayment
methods.description: Inserts a new payment record into the database with the specified method and status.

methods.name: updatePayment
methods.description: Updates an existing payment record identified by PID with new payment method and status.

methods.name: deletePayment
methods.description: Deletes a payment record from the database based on the payment ID.

methods.name: createPayment
methods.description: Creates a new payment record based on the payment method, setting the status accordingly, and retrieves the new payment ID.
